lines.trans: Where are you all marching off to?
Boss, where are you heading with that suitcase?
To Europe! I may no longer be Chief Content Officer, yet I am still chief producer of Unit One.
Now that I hold no executive title, I finally have time to go film Charming Voyage with you—am I welcome?

words.gloss: hold an official or executive title
words.gram: Meaning: hold an official or executive title.

lines.trans: Welcome! Wait—were we not about to stage a mutiny just now?
As if you would dare mutiny—hurry aboard and let us set off!
Boss, this whole mess dragged you down, and everyone feels really bad about it.
Do not overthink it; getting to join the filming of our original show in person makes me happier than I can say.
Out of our thirty-seven team rules, do you know how many you just broke?
Sorry, Chun Yuqiao, let me take a quick call—rest assured, we have found Chun Yuqiao.
Chun Yuqiao, I would like to request leave from this Europe trip because something came up at home.
Besides, I want to revise my thesis a couple more times and worry I would lack time in Europe.
Have you thought it through? Approved.

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.text: 这是都。
examples.trans: This is 都.

meanings.note: Executive title shǒuxí nèiróngguān ('Chief Content Officer').

examples.text: 恭喜您升任星天的首席内容官！
examples.trans: Congratulations on your promotion to Chief Content Officer!

examples.text: 首席内容官负责把关公司所有核心节目的品质。
examples.trans: The Chief Content Officer oversees quality across all flagship shows.

examples.text: 看到方案通过，大家都特别高兴。
examples.trans: Seeing the proposal pass made everyone very happy.

examples.text: 他今天看起来好像不太高兴。
examples.trans: He does not look very happy today.
